verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's homepage says users can "manage deals with AI," a first-party but vague claim of AI help inside the product. The "get insights" claim on the MCP-server page describes insights delivered through an external AI assistant, not inside Pipedrive, so it is a different story and is not credited here. Lead scoring and revenue forecasting are listed as workflow automation, not as AI-generated insights. Missing for 10: documentation of specific in-product AI insights or suggestion features (e.g., deal recommendations, AI summaries, next-best-action), details of how the AI analyzes the user's data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
